body: Fixed in 979fa5708. reveal_allowed_after is now normalized to an array before membership checks, so malformed values fail with controlled_vocabulary_violation and manual_reveal_without_attempt_confirmation instead of throwing. Added a malformed_reveal_allowed_after fixture/regression.

Fixed in 979fa5708. exposed_neighbor_question_labels is now required to be an array before count comparison; malformed string labels fail with page_exposure_count_mismatch instead of passing through string length. Added a malformed_page_exposure_labels fixture/regression.
Fixed in 979fa5708. Added fail-closed tests for null, string, and array inputs; each returns payload_not_object without throwing.

Fixed in 979fa5708. source_labeling_requirements now validates exact membership for every expected source label instead of checking length only. Added a missing_source_label_requirement fixture/regression.
